description:
Join me to change the world in abandoned but not forgotten:

We will tell everyone about abandoned satilites still in earth orbit, and how much space junk surrounds the earth. Will you join me?
summary: When people think of space junk, they just picture random trash surrounding Earth. This project tells the full story, and about how other planets have this, to.
details: It tells people the real truth about space junk. And it does not just talk about that, it has the solutions to. The intended impact is so that anyone even at NASA or around the world can hear this. And maybe NASA can make a change in this act.
